chunks: And give the women [upon marriage] their dower willingly, but if they give up of it willingly, then take it in good measure and ease.
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on a wife giving up part of her dowry?
ai.summary: In Shia jurisprudence, this verse establishes the mahr as the woman's exclusive property, emphasizing its nature as a gracious gift (nihlah) rather than a mere transaction. The condition of 'willingness' (tibn) highlights the importance of mutual consent in marital financial arrangements, allowing the husband to enjoy the portion returned without dispute. This principle underscores the dignity and economic autonomy granted to women within the Islamic family structure.
